entries.original: **Quick scanner nodes** extract per-chunk facts into bounded file reports. Chunks are 400 KB of source, roughly 100k tokens against a ~150k usable quick window, so `N_quick = ceil(S / CHUNK)`, bin-packed by directory.
entries.translated: **Quick scanner nodes** extract per-chunk facts into bounded file reports. Chunks are 400 KB of source, roughly 100k tokens against a ~150k usable quick window, so `N_quick = ceil(S / CHUNK)`, bin-packed by directory.

entries.original: **Unspecified-high writer nodes** own disjoint subtrees and write the `AGENTS.md` files from about 12 reports each: `N_high = ceil(N_quick / 12)`.
entries.translated: **Unspecified-high writer nodes** own disjoint subtrees and write the `AGENTS.md` files from about 12 reports each: `N_high = ceil(N_quick / 12)`.

entries.original: A **root writer** consumes only per-subtree digests, and a **verify node** gates every produced file before the run can claim success.
entries.translated: A **root writer** consumes only per-subtree digests, and a **verify node** gates every produced file before the run can claim success.

entries.original: The **always-reduce rule** makes context protection structural rather than aspirational: the main session reads only the verify verdict, never chunk reports or raw node output.
entries.translated: The **always-reduce rule** makes context protection structural rather than aspirational: the main session reads only the verify verdict, never chunk reports or raw node output.

entries.original: Typing **"mass ulw-loop"** now loads ultrawork + mass-ulw + ulw-loop together instead of nothing.
entries.translated: Typing **"mass ulw-loop"** now loads ultrawork + mass-ulw + ulw-loop together instead of nothing.

entries.original: **"ulw plan"** loads ultrawork + ulw-plan, via the new `omo-ulw-plan:skill-pointer` custom type.
entries.translated: **"ulw plan"** loads ultrawork + ulw-plan, via the new `omo-ulw-plan:skill-pointer` custom type.

entries.original: **Flag consolidation:** `omo-senpi-mass-ulw-disabled` and `omo-senpi-ulw-skill-pointers-disabled` are replaced by a single `omo-senpi-skill-pointers-disabled`. Move your flag if you had one set.
entries.translated: **Flag consolidation:** `omo-senpi-mass-ulw-disabled` and `omo-senpi-ulw-skill-pointers-disabled` are replaced by a single `omo-senpi-skill-pointers-disabled`. Move your flag if you had one set.

entries.original: **Cursor streams survive heartbeats and checkpoints.** The provider now matches the official Cursor CLI's stream recovery: its 30s health deadline is refreshed on every inbound frame, and pre-`turnEnded` stalls or transport deaths are silently retried with bounded backoff, resuming from the latest conversation checkpoint with the originally pinned model. Long-running local tools and long `xhigh` thinking turns previously died with `Cursor stream ended before turnEnded: inbound stream stalled` and immediately rotated the fallback chain.
entries.translated: **Cursor streams survive heartbeats and checkpoints.** The provider now matches the official Cursor CLI's stream recovery: its 30s health deadline is refreshed on every inbound frame, and pre-`turnEnded` stalls or transport deaths are silently retried with bounded backoff, resuming from the latest conversation checkpoint with the originally pinned model. Long-running local tools and long `xhigh` thinking turns previously died with `Cursor stream ended before turnEnded: inbound stream stalled` and immediately rotated the fallback chain.

entries.original: **Clean shutdown with prompts pending.** The `permission-system` builtin extension no longer turns a rejection during `session_shutdown` into an unhandled promise rejection / `uncaughtException` when permission prompts are still pending.
entries.translated: **Clean shutdown with prompts pending.** The `permission-system` builtin extension no longer turns a rejection during `session_shutdown` into an unhandled promise rejection / `uncaughtException` when permission prompts are still pending.

entries.original: **Ruby and Julia kernels boot safely under load.** Eval cells now wait for the subprocess `ready` signal before execution timeouts arm, so interpreter startup under load can no longer time out a state-setting cell and silently restart the kernel before the next cell runs.
entries.translated: **Ruby and Julia kernels boot safely under load.** Eval cells now wait for the subprocess `ready` signal before execution timeouts arm, so interpreter startup under load can no longer time out a state-setting cell and silently restart the kernel before the next cell runs.

entries.original: **Dependency pins:** the omo package now depends on **senpi 2026.8.22**, and `bun-types` moved **1.3.14 to 1.4.0** in the Codex plugin shared manifest, finishing the Bun 1.4 graduation started in beta.13.
entries.translated: **Dependency pins:** the omo package now depends on **senpi 2026.8.22**, and `bun-types` moved **1.3.14 to 1.4.0** in the Codex plugin shared manifest, finishing the Bun 1.4 graduation started in beta.13.

entries.original: **Bundle freshness:** the committed omo-senpi extension bundles were regenerated on Linux after each ULW component change, so the CI freshness gate and your installed extension agree byte-for-byte.
entries.translated: **Bundle freshness:** the committed omo-senpi extension bundles were regenerated on Linux after each ULW component change, so the CI freshness gate and your installed extension agree byte-for-byte.
